items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Benny Goodman, he was a kick him.

ctx.x: Well, I like all kinds, you know. I like old time and New Orleans numbers, I guess. Okay. And I like some of the old rags and blues. Now, I enjoyed this the other night when Duke

Gallatin and all those guys came on. Did you see that? No, but I know I wasn't interested in it. Oh, it was wonderful. I mean, I sit there and I just enjoy it to the highs because, uh, uh, Benny Goodman, he was a kick him. Yeah, I mean, you know, you know, your age doesn't have anything to do, to, to do with you in your work. You know what I mean? If you, uh,

You're gonna bring up something that's been interesting me for a long time. Do you know, I think it's amazing that musicians are so active in their field, the older they get, the more active they get. Uh, I'd love to know why.
